updates.производительность: The accepted author manuscript Sections II-IV and Figures 1-13 describe a split-electrode concentration-gradient model and compare predicted pulse artefact tails with bench measurements in 0.1× PBS using an Evoke implant. Figure 9 describes qualitative agreement; no fitted error metric is reported.
updates.ограничения: Accepted manuscript and linked IEEE VOR were checked at body level. Validation is saline bench testing, not human epidural ECAP artifact removal, analgesia or patient outcome prediction. Do not turn visual agreement into a quantitative accuracy claim; the extracted conductivity unit is ambiguous and is not used.

updates.производительность: Interim AVALON author abstract: 51 trialed, 36 implanted. ≥50% back/leg pain relief: 92.6%/91.3% at 3 months and 85.7%/82.6% at 6 months; ≥80% relief: 70.4%/56.5% at 3 months and 64.3%/60.9% at 6 months. These are selected-cohort author-reported proportions, not an ECAP-to-pain predictor.
updates.ограничения: Abstract-only interim AVALON report (51 trialed/36 implanted), separate from the later 70/50 same-cohort analysis. Exact responder denominator at each visit, uncertainty and full methods are unavailable. AVALON is single-arm/open-label ACTRN12615000713594, not NCT02161627 Panorama; concurrent improvement cannot isolate ECAP feedback benefit or establish individual prognosis.

validation.notes: Official PubMed PMID 28922517 author abstract checked 2026-09-28: exact 3/6-month back/leg ≥50% and ≥80% relief proportions copied with interim 51-trialed/36-implanted context. The article is abstract-only in this pass. Registered AVALON endpoint includes feedback-mode programmability, distinct from patient pain scores; no randomized comparison, visit-specific responder denominator or patient ECAP-to-pain linkage is established.
